topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I just found out my college application essay is being used as an example on the university website. I spent countless nights crafting that piece, pouring my heart into every word, and now it's out there for everyone to scrutinize. I didn't agree to this, didn't give my permission. They’re using my personal story as some kind of public exhibit. It's a violation, and I feel completely exposed. I'm ready to call the admissions office and demand they take it down. This isn’t right, and they need to know it.
